reserveReview.rationale: Issuer reserve API observed 2026-11-19: TKUSD 306092.282443025320983203, CUMFU 305030.173133658153915429 and FUIDL-AC 618414.168575201677475228 in issuer-marked USD, totaling 1229536.624151885152373860 against 1227691.888 FUSD supply (reserve ratio 1.001503). The tuple reconciles exactly to an on-chain bundle published the same morning: updateBundle tx 0x19a8c8858c0a0e3cff80826e6a748e3f0febce07432780148079915643b853da (Ethereum block 26447516, 2026-11-19T07:05:23Z) carries bundle timestamp 1795071881 = 2026-11-19T07:04:41Z and unit prices 10.39194, 104.718 and 1.025198. Treasury Safe 0x7c2E652F8bB1DA76D172e11f8a099C663B3fFF54 balances 29454.777687614181854707 TKUSD-F, 2912.872410986250252253 CUMFU-F and 603214.372809156550710427 FUIDL multiplied by those prices reproduce all three API values to full published precision. The publisher EOA 0xabc967e50c211DfD38Ddf7089b3838934C939e9A has submitted updateBundle calls roughly twice daily through proxy 0xc90EBba0868d4d6F2023A4B30146515Eb0F5c7A8 into the verified SimpleBundleAggregator code, so the observation is a live same-day snapshot. The API's updated_at 1776736295 remains the April 21 configuration timestamp and does not date the book; the bundle timestamp does. Percentages are the API's published six-decimal ratios (24.8949%, 24.8085%, 50.2965%). The three fund products and their value weights are materially unchanged from October. Slice names, classification fields and liquidity horizons carry over unchanged from the October review (Kaitai August 2026 memorandum Appendix D and ChinaAMC September 14 2026 prospectus Schedule 5 govern token-redemption delay categories; FUIDL-AC liquidity remains unknown). No finite maturityDaysMax is inferred. This records a current token-inventory and publisher-NAV observation, not a financial report or independently authenticated underlying fund holdings; independent reconciliation to fund-held assets, NAV administration, holder priority and recovery safeguards remains unverified across 100% of the book.
